findings.name: Azazel shield, admission and terminal state
findings.fact: AzazelEntity.hurt returns false on client, IN_WALL, attack states 7..10, and state 2. Before normal super.hurt it tests currentHealth-rawAmount <= maxHealth*0.05 and starts state-9 death cinematic, returning false. This is an incoming-amount threshold before ordinary mitigation, not measured HP damage or a 5%-HP subtraction. A LivingEntity source owner increments hitCounter before super.hurt success is known; threshold is uniformly sampled inclusively between sorted SHIELD_HITS_MIN/MAX (defaults 5..20). At threshold while state 0, counter resets, a new threshold is sampled, state 2 lasts attackTimer=100 and heal(20) is requested. The triggering hit still delegates to super.hurt. State-9 tick 200 creates loot/barrel and discards the boss without an explosion damage call. HitCounter/MercyTick/PhaseState/TotalAttacks/HasOfferedMercy are saved; attack state/timer, next threshold, prison list and Midas tracker are not saved by the shown overrides.

findings.name: Azazel native attack scheduling and mercy control
findings.fact: Aggro starts from a qualifying hurt path or nearby Player with vanilla BAD_OMEN (AABB inflate 30). Idle aggro with target uses 1/ATTACK_CHANCE per entity tick (default 80); after five chosen attacks it offers mercy once. A close-player AABB using MELEE_ATTACK_RADIUS (default 6) and random 0..99 < MELEE_ATTACK_CHANCE (30) selects Launch/Midas equally; otherwise Wind/Wheel/Arrow/Pull/Prison, plus Pray only with Believer in AABB40, are uniformly selected. Phase thresholds <=50% and <=25% set synchronized phase state; the shown attack formulas do not use phase. Mercy state6 clears target/navigation; timeout >284 entity ticks returns to aggro, or iron/diamond/netherite sword/axe interaction consumes one unless creative and enters state7. State7 tick76 enters state8; state8 forces Player lookAt boss eyes within AABB30 until tick40 then discards. Travel sets boss velocity ZERO in state2 or any state>=6. This is real forced orientation during a cinematic, separate from cosmetic subtitles.

findings.name: Azazel Wind/Pull/Launch/Wheel: four distinct control deliveries
findings.fact: All use native mobAttack(this), with no custom DamageType and no check of hurt return before their velocity effects. Wind state1 timer60: every active call Player AABB20 receives currentVelocity + (0.8*normalizedAway.x,0.2,0.8*normalizedAway.z); at timer30 requests configured damage5. Pull state11 timer60: while timer>15 add horizontal normalizedToward*0.6 to Player AABB20; timer15 sets Y velocity1.5 and requests damage5. Launch state12 timer80: timer40 Player AABB5 requests damage8 and sets Y velocity2.5. Its explosion particles/sound do not construct an Explosion. Wheel state3 timer90: timer<=50 with target sets boss horizontal normalizedToward*1.2; every third entity tick Player AABB1 requests damage4 and receives full dashVector*1.5 (including its normalized Y component). Player lists do not explicitly filter creative/spectator or test line of sight in these methods; native hurt eligibility remains downstream.

findings.name: Midas expanding fire ring and inventory replacement
findings.fact: State13 lasts120 entity-tick countdown, tracker cleared on start. Each perform call sets elapsed=120-timer and radius=elapsed/120*30. Players in AABB35 with abs(3D distance-radius)<=1.5 receive native inFire damage request MIDAS_FIRE_DAMAGE (8) and igniteForSeconds(5), without conditioning ignition on hurt success. At distance<=6 each UUID counter increments; reaching MIDAS_GOLD_TIME (40) replaces one uniformly chosen nonempty inventory container slot whose item is not RAW_GOLD with a fresh RAW_GOLD stack of the old count. Original item/components are not preserved. Scanned container size is delegated to vanilla Inventory and needs its own witness before claiming exact slot coverage. Outside6 but within35 resets counter; leaving the scanned AABB does not run that reset. Counters reset after each threshold even when no eligible slot exists. No creative/spectator exclusion in these loops. At timer110 it separately summons either configured StatueBossunit count3 or Guardian count2 on radius4; Guardians get current/fallback target and startSpawning.

findings.name: Azazel prison terrain control
findings.fact: State14 chooses current Player target or nearest Player40, saves its block position, timer=PRISON_DURATION(200). For elapsed10..50 with elapsed%4==0 (actual first12), step=(elapsed-10)/4 creates replaceable ring blocks satisfying round(sqrt(x*x+z*z))==radius (default5). Column maximum is max(3,PRISON_MAX_HEIGHT(6)-abs(x*31+z*17)%4), deterministic per x/z; step<=maxH. After elapsed50, if targetY+1 exceeds recorded highest wall, each call adds up to five layers of GRAND_DOOR_PART on that ring in replaceable cells. No explicit teleport or velocity lock. At expiry/death-cinematic/removal, tracked locations still containing BLACKSTONE_COLUMN or GRAND_DOOR_PART become AIR. Original replaced states are not restored, and locations/timer are not persisted by Azazel save overrides. Removal/world reload behavior needs no fabricated runtime claim.

findings.name: Believer protection, sickness, healing and death callback
findings.fact: Azazel Pray starts state5 timer180 and calls setProtected(150) on Believers in AABB40. Believer protected boolean causes unconditional false return from hurt before super; server protectedTimer decrements/clears it. Gunpowder interaction sets custom IS_SICK, golden apple clears it, consumes one unless creative. Sick OR praying stops navigation and delegates travel(Vec3.ZERO), but sickness does not gate heal logic. Every20 entity ticks Believer retains current live Azazel if distanceSquared<1600, otherwise selects first in AABB30. A live selected boss receives heal(5) every20 ticks; no aggro, sickness or protected-state gate. On server die, a Player source owner receives vanilla BAD_OMEN36000 amp0 and a Statue is spawned before super.die. All are distinct from the empty ZoneEffect markers.

findings.name: Guardian mega-punch and Welcomer aura
findings.fact: Mega punch requests mobAttack damage10 unbuffed/15 buffed within AABB10/20 and distanceSquared<=100/400. Excludes self, Welcomer, Manipulator, Believer, Guardian, StatueBossunit, Statue and Azazel; remaining LivingEntities receive velocityY+0.9 independent of hurt return. No invulnerableTime reset in this path. Goal enters special if16<distanceSquared<=100, specCooldown0 and random1/20; state5 timer40 calls punch at30 and sets cooldown160 goal invocations. Every10 server entity ticks Welcomer sets IS_CASTING if any Guardian with target in AABB30; every10 Guardian ticks IS_BUFFED becomes whether any nearby Welcomer isCasting. This is a custom boolean range/damage switch, not Strength attribute effect; it does not stack with multiple Welcomers. Guardian death only plays WEAKNESS sound to others, not a Weakness effect.

findings.name: Gilded Golem healing pull package
findings.fact: Below/equal25% max HP while alive enters saved IsHealingPhase until full or no candidate ItemEntity/eligible Player in AABB10. Eligible players exclude creative, spectator, dead and recorded creatorUUID. Pull adds horizontal normalizedToward*0.15 to current velocity and sets hurtMarked. Items have priority: first item within distanceSquared<2.5 is discarded as a whole entity (entire stack), heal(4), then no Player branch that tick. Otherwise each player is pulled; distanceSquared<3.5 every20 entity ticks requests native magic damage2 then heal(6), with no hurt-success condition or measured-damage ratio. Separate successful super IronGolem.doHurtTarget adds velocityY0.4; inherited launch must be compared before claiming total knockback. Creator and IsHealingPhase are saved. Every10 ticks while no target/not healing it can target a living recent attacker of a Believer within AABB15, excluding its creator.

findings.name: Laser moving magic/fire hazard and immunity
findings.fact: LaserEntity is a Mob with no attack goal, not AbstractArrow. It is unpickable/unpushable, empty knockback/push callbacks, hurt always false, no normal despawn. Each server tick moves by direct setPos: horizontal angle vector*0.15 + perpendicular vector*sin(tickCount*0.3)*0.15, angle perturbed by[-30,30) degrees every10 ticks. Every2 entity ticks alive noncreative Players intersecting its own AABB receive native magic request5, then absolute setRemainingFireTicks(60) without hurt-return check. LifeTicks starts1200, saved; discard requires life<=0 AND tickCount>1200, so saved life alone is not the removal timer after reload. No fabricated projectile source identity.

findings.name: Statue observation lock and one-hit state
findings.fact: Each server tick scans all level Players, excluding spectator/dead, and at eye-to-eye distance<64, normalized view dot target direction>0.1 plus player.hasLineOfSight(statue), sets isFrozen. On transition to frozen it stops navigation and resets hasAttacked=false; while observed velocity is multiplied(0,1,0). On unobserved clears frozen. Nested StatueAttackGoal admission/continuation requires !isFrozen && !hasAttacked; its successful scheduling branch calls doHurtTarget then sets hasAttacked=true regardless of hurt return. Thus one attack attempt per released observation cycle. This is custom AI/motion control, not frozenTicks or an applied freeze status.
